articles.summary: NioCorp Developments Ltd. (“NioCorp,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ:NB), a leading U.S. critical minerals developer, today announced that construction of the main access to the underground portion of the Company’s Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project (the “Elk Creek Project”) in southeast Nebraska has now begun.
articles.title: NioCorp Launches Construction of Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project Mine Portal

articles.summary: NioCorp Developments Ltd. (“NioCorp,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ:NB), today announced the closing of its previously announced public offering in the United States (the “Offering”).
articles.title: NioCorp Announces Closing of $100.0 Million Public Offering of Common Shares
